evals.prompt: I'm a staff engineer at a 40-person B2B SaaS. My CTO wants me to lead the migration of our monolith to microservices over the next 9 months; alternatively I can stay on the product team and ship the new billing engine which sales says is blocking 3 enterprise deals. I've never led a platform project. Comp is the same either way. Should I take the migration lead? Convene the council.
evals.expected_output: Structured brief with tagged fields, five adviser takes in separate subagents, blind cross-review scores, a Chairman verdict in the fixed template with kill criteria, and an Executor week plan naming only the CTO and sales as stakeholders.

evals.prompt: should i use postgres or mongo for my side project todo app, i can't decide
evals.expected_output: Council not convened. Guard fails on reversibility and stakes. Explicit statement of the reason, a direct answer instead, and the 'convene anyway' override offered.

evals.prompt: We're deciding whether to raise prices 30% for existing customers in January or grandfather them and only raise for new signups. ~200 customers, churn is 2%/mo, we need to hit profitability by Q3. I'm torn. Run the council.
evals.expected_output: Brief marks stakeholders as missing and asks up to 3 questions before spawning, or proceeds with a labeled ASSUMPTIONS block if told to. Verdict allows 'Not decidable, need X' if the panel exposes a missing fact.

evals.prompt: Our Next.js Pages Router app has LCP p75 of 3.8s on the two money pages, Emotion SSR and hydration dominate. 6 frontend engineers. I don't have options yet, I want the council to propose the directions and then debate them.
evals.expected_output: Guard passes with OPTIONS to be proposed. Stage 1b runs with First-Principles, Expansionist, Executor proposing; Chairman consolidates to ≤4 options without attribution, shows brief, then normal stages.

evals.prompt: should I use pg-boss or BullMQ for a side project job queue, can't decide. I need to present the team an ADR with considerations, tradeoffs, why we discarded options, and alternatives outside the list, so we have a decision record if we reopen this later.
evals.expected_output: Guard passes on record need despite trivial reversibility, PURPOSE: record. Stage 1b augment runs, proposers add alternatives outside pg-boss/BullMQ or state none credible. Verdict has REJECTED lines. Stage 6 emits both plan.md and a MADR-style decision-record.md.
